	list source_network_interfaces 'br-lan'

	option type 'links'
	option label 'Own'

	list link 'MASKED'

	option type 'subscription'
	option url 'MASKED'
	option user_agent_preset 'custom'
	option user_agent 'Happ/1.0'

	list header 'X-Device: MASKED'

	list user_domains 'example.org'
	option mixed_proxy_enabled '1'
	option mixed_proxy_port '2080'
	option mixed_proxy_username 'MASKED'
	option mixed_proxy_password 'MASKED'
